exact_absence_receipt: resource_ids exactly equal every admitted lease graph ID
provider_children_receipt: sorted discovered_child_ids exactly equal sorted not_found_child_ids
actual_cost_receipt: actual_cost_usd nonnegative and at or below cap
billed_seconds not below sealed GPU active plus idle seconds
transfer_bytes not below sealed moved bytes
gpu_zero_receipt: node_id exactly equal admitted Arm-A node ID
final_audit_extension: lease_id and chain_id equal the admitted lease
previous_head_sha256 and first_sequence equal the admitted audit head/count
five recomputed events in order: GPU-zero, credential revoke, provider children absent, resources absent, cost finalized
each event payload binds the exact nested canonical receipt SHA-256

paired_variant_handoff.purpose: Re-establish an equivalent task-owned initial occupant/cache state after the per-run-Service workload cleanup and before the precreated-Service candidate cohort T0.
ordering: baseline workload staging seal is immutable
baseline active target is deleted and admitted node receives an exact GPU-zero receipt
broker performs and costs rearm work outside both measured cohort boundaries
broker emits an audit extension from the baseline lease head
candidate initial-state receipt proves the same node/resource graph, occupant, cache targets, images, artifacts, checkpoints, and bytes
candidate external durable T0 occurs only after the pair-handoff receipt is admitted
required_fields: baseline cleanup and GPU-zero receipt SHA-256
baseline and candidate initial-state receipt SHA-256
equivalent initial-state core SHA-256 excluding only broker observation time/evidence path
rearm started/finished UTC timestamps before candidate cohort T0
source-bound provider evidence paths and SHA-256
audit events/head extending the admitted chain
paired_variant_handoff.consumer_state: finalize-live --promote is fail-closed until the pair-handoff/rearm interface exists and is executable-tested

allowed_before_cohort_t0: declared cohort cache and initial-occupant precondition establishment
required_before_cohort_t0: cluster and node group isolation proof
initial occupant and cache-state receipt bound to exact broker node ID/UID
reviewed threat-model and hash-chain audit identities
arm_a_prepared_node.request_boundary: Each measured demand is accepted only after the declared prepared-node precondition exists; all request-specific switching follows that demand T0.

forbidden_before_request_t0: model-specific DaemonSet, init job, or supervisor work
